trivia.text: Rick Moranis suggested John Candy for the role of Barf.
Spaceballs marked the fourth time that John Candy worked with Rick Moranis, the actor who portrayed Dark Helmet.
His tail moved when a button in Candy's paw was pressed.
His ears were controlled by Creature FX Puppeteer Rick Lazzarini.
Barf's rank on the 5-Man Band would be the Big Guy.
